author: abcoathup
content:
**Polar bear selected as mascot for Glamsterdam upgrade**

🐻‍❄️ Polar bear was selected, please update upgrade related artwork.  

If a rough consensus of client teams want to veto the selected mascot (as per EIP-8066), then I suggest that ACDC #184 is the best & last chance to do that.  Flamingo would then be the mascot.

> A rough consensus of client teams MAY veto the selected mascot, triggering fallback to the next-highest-ranked candidate mascot.

From: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8066
